why: Items 1, 2 and 4 are covered. Builder step 7 says "Run `npm install` at the repo root so package-lock.json records the new workspace". Step 6 says "replace the 'No tools yet' bullet". Verifier Check 6 reads the PR body and headRefOid and runs `gh pr checks` against the workflow at the head commit. Item 3 is missing. The verifier never confirms that the jsonl-lint tests actually run under the root `npm test`. Check 4 runs `npm test -w jsonl-lint`, which is the workspace-scoped command, not the root one. Check 6 only looks at the exit status of the root `npm test` ("local npm test exits 0"). It does not read the test count from the root run or break lint() to see a test fail. So a silent skip caused by `--if-present`, or a run that finds zero tests, would still pass.
